basic_profile.bio: I'm a 20-year-old fashion enthusiast from New York City with a passion for virtual trading and an eye for rare items. I recently discovered Reddit and have been diving deep into gaming communities, especially Royale High. I'm a college student, majoring in fashion design, and I often browse Reddit in the evenings after classes. I love connecting with people over shared interests and occasionally play Hogwarts Mystery on my breaks. Not a big fan of overly complex trading negotiations, I prefer straightforward deals. Single, and always open to making new friends online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught in virtual trading through hands-on experience in game environments like Royale High. I also have some background in fashion design, which aids in evaluating in-game item aesthetics and value. My knowledge is supplemented by following trading trends and tips shared by more experienced players on Reddit.
